subject: Purged Status - unable to delete or overwrite

messages.author: e5563c64d65403a1
messages.subject: Purged Status - unable to delete or overwrite
parts:
So far Shinyapps has been phenomenal for our use case, however, having one little issue that haven't been able to find a resolution for yet. 

Similar to this question: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!newtopic/shinyapps-users/shinyapps-users/4KERuRhVjEc

I have an application in purged status. However, as you can see from the screenshot, it is not allowing deletion unless in archived status and not allowing archival of an application in purged status. 

I have also attempted to overwrite this through a deployment from rsconnect and rstudio separately and so far unsuccessfully. And regardless of the app id, I'd like to remove this application so that I can use the name/link as this is the link already used by a number of people. I acknowledge that I will have to re-invite the users and re-authenticate all of them with a new deployment and that is fine.

I also waited a period of time (1 day) as described in the question above but at least in my situation, this has not resolved itself.

Current app ID # 190913.

Thanks.

Scott
